# Pretendard score fonts

Unmodified official Pretendard 1.3.9 static webfonts. License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; full text in OFL.txt and in exported SVG styles.

Source: https://github.com/orioncactus/pretendard/tree/v1.3.9/packages/pretendard/dist/web/static/woff2

| Asset | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---|
| Pretendard-Regular.woff2 | 765892 | fad853f7f47c6c8b103171e7193fa095708cdcd70850a71d93aa5379e8a61d63 |
| Pretendard-Bold.woff2 | 791156 | 4609c3356e536fafe38f4add0daeceb3d8595d3057bce13c428c33ddbd43d362 |
| OFL.txt | 4418 | d31ddd9f2bed32fd7e302a205cf2380ba0de6529152d239ef99cfb6f261bfc04 |

The shared score renderer waits for these exact faces before measurement and embeds only used weights in exported SVG. Score text uses Pretendard; music notation keeps its dedicated glyphs. The original binaries are not subsetted or modified. General application UI is outside this scope.
